purpose: N4 v3 style diagnostic: surface shift under merged same-entity targets; surface only, not a quality gate
finding: The merged targets transferred: v3b emits ~1.03 sentences per group and ~2.64 facts per sentence, close to the merged target (1.04/2.41), versus ~1.72/1.68 for the one-fact models. But v3b passes 62/66 hard gates vs the old v2-on-v2 64/66, and the guard-on alternating row still fails (v3b omits the middle task; v3a misattributes it to the next actor). Style moved; hard fidelity did not improve, so v3b is an experimental arm, not the replacement default.
